newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian parliament to take govt vote by Feb 7.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian parliament to take govt vote by Feb 7.

text.p: Slovenia's parliament is likely to decide whether to approve a new government by February 7, a parliamentary official said on Monday.
"I expect the vote, which depends on the speed of other parliamentary procedures, will take place between February 5 and 7," said the general secretary of parliament, Jozica Veliscek.

She said parliamentary questioning of ministerial candidates would start on Tuesday and end on Friday. If a candidate is rejected, Prime Minister-designate Janez Drnovsek has three days to make another nominatation.
Drnovsek formed a coalition government with a majority of just one vote on Friday.
The coalition comprises Drnovsek's centre-left Liberal Democrats, the former communist party the United List of Social Democrats, the Desus party representing pensioners, and the Nationalist party.
